translations.EN: You are bold. I cannot say I dislike that.
translations.TL: Matapang ka. Hindi ko masasabing ayaw ko niyan.

translations.EN: Well, you certainly do not beat around the bush.
translations.TL: Talagang hindi ka paligoy-ligoy.

translations.EN: That is quite a statement out of nowhere.
translations.TL: Mabigat na pahayag 'yan nang walang babala.

translations.EN: You have got nerve. I will hand that to you.
translations.TL: May lakas ka ng loob. Ibibigay ko sa 'yo 'yon.

translations.EN: Bold move. Let us see if you can back it up.
translations.TL: Matapang na hakbang. Tingnan natin kung kaya mong panindigan.

translations.EN: I like confidence, but do not get ahead of yourself.
translations.TL: Gusto ko ang tiwala sa sarili, pero huwag kang magpadalos-dalos.

translations.EN: You definitely know what you want.
translations.TL: Alam na alam mo talaga ang gusto mo.

translations.EN: Straight to the point. I can appreciate that.
translations.TL: Diretso sa punto. Pinahahalagahan ko 'yan.

translations.EN: You are playing with high stakes here.
translations.TL: Mataas ang pustahan mo rito.

translations.EN: Bold words. Do not make promises you cannot keep.
translations.TL: Matatapang na salita. Huwag kang mangako ng hindi mo kayang tuparin.

translations.EN: That is a very direct proposition.
translations.TL: Napakadiretsang alok niyan.

translations.EN: You do not waste time, do you?
translations.TL: Hindi ka talaga nagsasayang ng oras, 'no?

translations.EN: Straight forward and unfiltered. Noted.
translations.TL: Diretso at walang paligoy-ligoy. Malinaw.

translations.EN: That is about as clear as it gets.
translations.TL: Kasing-linaw na 'yan ng tubig.

translations.EN: No subtlety with you at all, huh?
translations.TL: Wala talagang pahi-pahiwatig sa 'yo, ha?

translations.EN: Well, there is no mistaking what you are after.
translations.TL: Walang duda kung ano ang hinahabol mo.

translations.EN: Direct propositions require some thinking over.
translations.TL: Ang diretsang alok ay kailangan munang pag-isipan.

translations.EN: I heard every word. You made yourself very clear.
translations.TL: Narinig ko ang bawat salita. Naging napakalinaw mo.

translations.EN: At least you are honest about your intentions.
translations.TL: Kahit paano tapat ka sa mga balak mo.

translations.EN: That is blunt. Let us see where this goes.
translations.TL: Prangka 'yon. Tingnan natin kung saan ito hahantong.

translations.EN: You are moving fast, but I heard you.
translations.TL: Mabilis ang takbo mo, pero narinig kita.

translations.EN: Slow your roll a bit, but message received.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan lang muna, pero nakuha ko ang mensahe.

translations.EN: Pace yourself. We have got all night.
translations.TL: Huwag kang magmadali. Mahaba pa ang gabi.

translations.EN: You are rushing ahead, but I am listening.
translations.TL: Nagmamadali ka, pero nakikinig ako.

translations.EN: Fast moves can be exciting, but watch your footing.
translations.TL: Nakareregalo ang mabilis na galaw, pero mag-ingat sa hakbang.

translations.EN: I heard you loud and clear. Take a breath.
translations.TL: Narinig kita nang malakas at malinaw. Huminga ka muna.

translations.EN: You move quick. Let us see if you have endurance.
translations.TL: Mabilis kang kumilos. Tingnan natin kung may tibay ka.

translations.EN: Do not rush a good thing.
translations.TL: Huwag mong madaliin ang magandang bagay.

translations.EN: I caught your drift. Let us take it one beat at a time.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko ang ibig mong sabihin. Dahan-dahan lang muna tayo.

translations.EN: Heard you. Let us see how the evening unfolds.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Tingnan natin kung paano tatakbo ang gabi.
